lines.text:
THE BELT
A slow belt carries flat, cleared things past the hooks: a hat, a clock, a small bell.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: The belt runs on into a chute lit by a single red lamp. The lamp is a lens. It turns toward the Hollow, and the circle blinks once.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: The camera pulls back. The Hollow is quiet.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: The causeway is stone slabs over a pit of mist. A pair of lamps burns at each stop, one for every leg.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: The circle stands. Slice and Wallit are on the books. Thanks for playing.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text:
THE CLEARING FLOOR
Beyond the broken gate a yard lies sunken in the dark, lit by lamps along a slow conveyor.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text:
THE GATE
No handle. No hinges. No doormat. Wallit knocks with the bat.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text:
THE HALF-BUILT
The belt has stopped. In the chute, the Half-Built Yo Bot still hangs by one hook, one claw out, wanting finishing.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: The last pair of lamps. Ahead the slabs end in the mist, and something tall is walking up them, slowly, to wait.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text:
THE LAST STAMP
The order drops, unsigned. The ring on the grass waits for one more stamp.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: The lever drops. Down the line the hooks swing empty, and the belt coughs and stops.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text:
THE LONG WALK
A causeway of stone slabs runs out over a pit of mist, six lamps on either side. A single path. No cover.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: The Moonlit Hollow, changed. The wall of the Department is a row of broken stumps, and a path of pale slabs runs out to nothing.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text:
THE MOONLIT HOLLOW
The wall is gone. A path of pale slabs leads out of the Hollow and stops at nothing. The circle is brighter than it has ever been.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text:
THE NOTICE
The Courier comes apart. Its notice drifts down onto the grass. Nobody has signed it.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre
